segments.text:
V. 18.
Whatſoever ye ſhall hind on earth—By Excommunication, pronounced in the Spirit and Power of Chriſt. Whatſoever ye ſhall looſe—By Abſolution from that Sentence. In the Primitive Church, Abſolution meant no more than a Diſcharge from Church Cenſure. Again I ſay—And not only your Interceſſion for the Penitent, but all your united Prayers ſhall be heard. How great then is the Power of joint Prayer! If two of you—Suppoſe a Man and his Wife.
